rawResults.Title: Use voice input with Copilot CLI - GitHub Docs
rawResults.DisplayUrl: https://docs.github.com › en › copilot › how-tos › copilot-cli › use-copilot-cli › voice-input
rawResults.Snippet: Before you can dictate prompts, you need to download the voice runtime that powers speech recognition, and a voice model. In an interactive Copilot CLI session, enter the /voice slash command. When prompted, select Continue to download the voice runtime. The download runs in the background. You can keep using Copilot CLI while it completes.
